lines.zh: 白石鳞片一摆，我贴着河底滑出去。
lines.en: One flick of my white scales and I glide along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水草擦过我的背，我换个方向游。
lines.en: The weeds brush my back, so I swim the other way.

lines.zh: 我只在水里走，岸上一步也不去。
lines.en: I only travel in water; not one step on land.

lines.zh: 白宝石似的身子，在水里闪一下就远。
lines.en: My gem-white body flashes once and is gone.

lines.zh: 顺着水流，我绕开那块尖石头。
lines.en: Riding the current, I steer around that sharp stone.

lines.zh: 尾巴拍两下，我钻进更深的洼地。
lines.en: Two beats of my tail and I slip into deeper hollows.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，怕碰响水面的光。
lines.en: I swim slowly, afraid to disturb the light on the surface.

lines.zh: 石缝里通透，我从中间穿了过去。
lines.en: The gap in the stones is clear, so I thread through it.

lines.zh: 河湾转了个弯，我也跟着转。
lines.en: The river bends, and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我沿着浅滩巡一圈，再回深水。
lines.en: I patrol the shallows once, then return to deep water.

lines.zh: 沙底留下我细细的尾痕。
lines.en: My thin tail leaves a trail across the sandy bottom.

lines.zh: 水凉一点，我就往石头多的地方去。
lines.en: When the water cools, I head for the stony places.

lines.zh: 有人在上游涉水，我先躲进阴影。
lines.en: Someone wades upstream, so I hide in the shade first.

lines.zh: 我绕着睡莲根游，像绕一根柱子。
lines.en: I circle the lily root as if around a pillar.

lines.zh: 我的鳞像磨过的白石，晃一下就暗。
lines.en: My scales are like cut white stone, flashing then dim.

lines.zh: 水面一有响动，我就往石缝里钻。
lines.en: At the first splash, I slip into the rocks.

lines.zh: 悬在水里不动，我数着气泡往上走。
lines.en: Hanging still, I count the bubbles rising past me.

lines.zh: 我只有两颗心的力气，得省着用。
lines.en: I have only two hearts of strength, so I spend it sparingly.

lines.zh: 白鳞上落了层细泥，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Fine silt settles on my white scales, and I shiver it off.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子晃，我盯着看很久。
lines.en: Shadows waver on the surface; I watch them a long while.

lines.zh: 我把嘴贴在水草上，什么也不吃。
lines.en: I press my mouth to the weeds and eat nothing.

lines.zh: 水底很静，只有我鳃盖开合的声音。
lines.en: The bottom is quiet except for my gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 我藏在石影里，让白鳞暗下去。
lines.en: I hide in the stone's shadow and let my white scales dim.

lines.zh: 一片叶子沉下来，我让开了。
lines.en: A leaf sinks toward me, and I drift aside.

lines.zh: 水声在头顶响，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: Water murmurs overhead; I cannot be bothered to look up.

lines.zh: 我把身体摆成一条线，随水微动。
lines.en: I hold my body in a line and sway with the water.

lines.zh: 白色在水里太亮，我总想找暗处。
lines.en: White is too bright underwater; I always seek the dark.

lines.zh: 有只鱼游过去，我没有跟。
lines.en: Another fish swims past, and I do not follow.

lines.zh: 我数着石头的个数，数到第七块就忘了。
lines.en: I count the stones and lose track at the seventh.

lines.zh: 鳃里过一遍水，像叹了一口长气。
lines.en: Water passes my gills like one long sigh.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，白得像另一块石头。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, pale as another stone.

lines.zh: 你的影子投进水里，我退开半尺。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into the water, and I back away.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我也在看你，谁先动？
lines.en: You watch me, I watch you — who moves first?

lines.zh: 我不是宝石，别伸手来捞我。
lines.en: I am not a jewel, so do not reach in to grab me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子滴水，我就知道你来过河边。
lines.en: Your boots drip, so I know you walked the river.

lines.zh: 水里才是我的地方，你在外面站着。
lines.en: The water is my place; you stand outside it.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，我的鳞也跟着紧了一下。
lines.en: You bend lower, and my scales tighten a little.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里有网，我往深处沉。
lines.en: I see the net in your hand and sink deeper.

lines.zh: 白宝石在暗水里很显眼，这我知道。
lines.en: I know my white gem body shows in dark water.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的工夫，我已经换了位置。
lines.en: In the blink of your eye, I have already moved.

lines.zh: 疼！我往石缝里钻，别追。
lines.en: Ouch! I dive into the crevice — do not follow.

lines.zh: 白鳞掉了一片，我得更快才行。
lines.en: A white scale came off; I must be faster.

lines.zh: 我只有两颗心，经不起第二下。
lines.en: I have only two hearts; a second blow would finish me.

lines.zh: 你打中我了，我现在只想逃。
lines.en: You hit me; now I only want to flee.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑，我借着浑水跑。
lines.en: The water muddies, and I run under its cover.

lines.zh: 我躲得慢了一点，就挨了这一下。
lines.en: I dodged a moment too slow and took this hit.

lines.zh: 别打了，我身上没有值钱的东西。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; there is nothing valuable on me.

lines.zh: 疼得我尾巴都僵了，还硬要游。
lines.en: The pain stiffens my tail, yet I still force myself to swim.

lines.zh: 我贴到河底，让泥盖住白鳞。
lines.en: I press to the bottom and let mud cover my white scales.

lines.zh: 这一下记住了，我会离你远些。
lines.en: I will remember this blow and keep my distance.

lines.zh: 有面包屑落水，我绕了三圈才靠近。
lines.en: Bread crumbs hit the water; I circle three times before nearing.

lines.zh: 那条小虫在动，我盯得鳃都停了。
lines.en: That little worm wriggles, and I stare until my gills stop.

lines.zh: 你手里的亮东西，比食物还勾我。
lines.en: The bright thing in your hand draws me more than food.

lines.zh: 我不该过去，可那点碎屑在沉。
lines.en: I should not go, but those crumbs are sinking.

lines.zh: 一丁点腥味散开，我就忘了怕。
lines.en: A hint of blood spreads, and I forget to be afraid.

lines.zh: 我靠近一点，再靠近一点，就一点。
lines.en: I come closer, then closer still — just a little.

lines.zh: 水面落下一片影子，我以为是吃的。
lines.en: A shadow lands on the water, and I take it for food.

lines.zh: 饿了很久，连水草我都想咬一口。
lines.en: Hungry so long, I would bite even the water weeds.

lines.zh: 你要是丢下东西，我就当它是给我的。
lines.en: If you drop something, I will assume it is mine.

lines.zh: 我绕着那点光转，像绕着一颗小太阳。
lines.en: I circle that glimmer like a tiny sun.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里了，我撞在你膝上。
lines.en: You stepped into the water; I bumped into your knee.

lines.zh: 对不起，我游得太急，没看路。
lines.en: Sorry, I swam too fast and did not watch where I went.

lines.zh: 石头和我撞了一下，两个都没事。
lines.en: The stone and I collided, and neither of us is hurt.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太硬，我的鼻子吃亏了。
lines.en: Your boot is too hard; my nose takes the loss.

lines.zh: 我又被水流推到你那边，不是故意的。
lines.en: The current pushed me your way again — not on purpose.

lines.zh: 白鳞被蹭花了一点，你别再动。
lines.en: My white scales got scuffed; please stop moving.

lines.zh: 撞一下不疼，我只是躲得慢了。
lines.en: Bumping does not hurt; I was just slow to dodge.

lines.zh: 两个影子在水底撞上，是我和你。
lines.en: Two shadows meet on the riverbed — mine and yours.

lines.zh: 我该绕开的，这水太浅，我转不了弯。
lines.en: I should have gone around, but this shallows is too tight to turn.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我们就都不挤了。
lines.en: Step back half a pace and we both have room.

lines.zh: 你也是白宝石颜色的吗？那太好了。
lines.en: Are you white-gem coloured too? That would be wonderful.

lines.zh: 在浅水湾里，我们互相绕圈就好。
lines.en: In the shallow bay, let us just circle each other.

lines.zh: 我这条小鱼，只认得同类的白鳞。
lines.en: A small fish like me knows only its own kind's white scales.

lines.zh: 水草是我们的窝，别把它撞散了。
lines.en: These weeds are our nest; do not knock them apart.

lines.zh: 春天的水暖，你游慢一点等我。
lines.en: The spring water is warm; swim slower and wait for me.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴并在一起，就不会被冲散。
lines.en: Two tails side by side will not be swept apart.

lines.zh: 你的鳞是白的，我怎么看都不腻。
lines.en: Your scales are white, and I never tire of looking.

lines.zh: 我们藏在同一块石头下面，谁也不出去。
lines.en: We hide under the same stone, neither leaving.

lines.zh: 我数过的石头，现在也要数给你听。
lines.en: The stones I counted, I now want to count for you.

lines.zh: 若有别的鱼来，你就往我这里靠。
lines.en: If another fish comes, lean toward me.

lines.zh: 这枚小小的，正好能塞进嘴里。
lines.en: This one is small enough to fit in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我捡了东西，却不知该放哪里。
lines.en: I picked something up and do not know where to put it.

lines.zh: 亮的东西沉下来，我就用嘴顶住。
lines.en: When bright things sink, I hold them with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我嘴里已经有石头了，别再给我。
lines.en: I already have a stone in my mouth — no more.

lines.zh: 这块比我的鳞还白，我要留着。
lines.en: This is whiter than my scales; I will keep it.

lines.zh: 我衔着它游了两圈，尾巴都翘起来。
lines.en: I carried it two laps with my tail lifted high.

lines.zh: 掉在水底的东西，我总能找到。
lines.en: Things dropped on the riverbed, I always find.

lines.zh: 太重了，我用头顶着往石头缝推。
lines.en: Too heavy; I push it into the crevice with my head.

lines.zh: 你掉的那颗，我替你收好了。
lines.en: The one you dropped — I have kept it safe.

lines.zh: 我捡东西不为用，只是喜欢闪。
lines.en: I collect not for use, but for the glitter.

lines.zh: 水面有动静，我抬起头去看。
lines.en: Something stirs on the surface; I raise my head to look.

lines.zh: 有人下水了，我记住他的方向。
lines.en: Someone entered the water; I note which way they went.

lines.zh: 那道影子又来了，这次更近。
lines.en: That shadow is back, and closer this time.

lines.zh: 我盯上了漂下来的一片叶子。
lines.en: I fix my eyes on a leaf drifting down.

lines.zh: 有东西在水草里动，我停住了。
lines.en: Something moves in the weeds, and I freeze.

lines.zh: 那张网在动，我认得它的形状。
lines.en: That net is moving; I know its shape.

lines.zh: 我看见白影一闪，以为那是同类。
lines.en: A white flash — I took it for one of my kind.

lines.zh: 有鱼闯进我的石缝，我记住了它。
lines.en: A fish intrudes on my crevice; I remember it.

lines.zh: 我先看清，再决定要不要跑。
lines.en: I look first, then decide whether to flee.

lines.zh: 有重物踩进浅滩，水纹传到我这里。
lines.en: Heavy steps enter the shallows; the ripples reach me.

lines.zh: 我不动，等它先动，再决定逃。
lines.en: I stay still, let it move first, then decide to flee.

lines.zh: 那影子慢下来了，我的鳍也慢下来。
lines.en: The shadow slows, and so do my fins.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头，把自己当成一块白石头。
lines.en: I press to the stone and become a white stone.

lines.zh: 它还在看这边，我就再沉半尺。
lines.en: It still looks this way, so I sink another half foot.

lines.zh: 我退到水草后面，只留一只眼。
lines.en: I withdraw behind the weeds, leaving one eye out.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就往反方向转。
lines.en: The moment it moves, I turn the other way.

lines.zh: 我的目标是那道石缝，很近，也很窄。
lines.en: My goal is that crevice — near, and narrow.

lines.zh: 我数着它的呼吸，等它失去兴趣。
lines.en: I count its breaths, waiting for interest to fade.

lines.zh: 白鳞太显眼，我尽量侧着身子。
lines.en: White scales show too well, so I turn edge-on.

lines.zh: 它若下水，我就先钻到石头底下。
lines.en: If it enters the water, I duck under the stone first.

lines.zh: 我只是撞你一下，别当真。
lines.en: I only bumped you once; do not take it seriously.

lines.zh: 你用网碰我，我就咬网绳。
lines.en: You touched me with the net, so I bite the cord.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，我的牙就那么小。
lines.en: This bite is light; my teeth are just that small.

lines.zh: 我顶你脚踝，是想让你退开。
lines.en: I butt your ankle hoping you will step back.

lines.zh: 别抓我，我会甩尾巴打你的手。
lines.en: Do not grab me; I will slap your hand with my tail.

lines.zh: 我咬的是水，大多数时候咬空。
lines.en: I bite the water and mostly catch nothing.

lines.zh: 一颗心的力气，也就够撞这一下。
lines.en: One heart of strength is enough for this one bump.

lines.zh: 我发狠也就一瞬间，然后就跑。
lines.en: My fury lasts an instant, then I run.

lines.zh: 别把我当宝石捏，我会咬人。
lines.en: Do not squeeze me like a gem; I bite.

lines.zh: 这一口不算攻击，只是提醒。
lines.en: This nip is not an attack, only a warning.

lines.zh: 我从河底的卵石缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I slip out from the pebbles at the river bottom.

lines.zh: 水刚漫过石滩，我就出现了。
lines.en: The water has just covered the shoal, and here I am.

lines.zh: 这条河湾安静，我就在这里落脚。
lines.en: This bend is quiet, so I settle here.

lines.zh: 白鳞先亮，然后我整条鱼才动。
lines.en: My white scales shine first, then the rest of me moves.

lines.zh: 主世界的水里，总会有我这样的小东西。
lines.en: In overworld water there is always something small like me.

lines.zh: 我不记得怎么来的，只记得水很凉。
lines.en: I do not recall arriving, only that the water was cold.

lines.zh: 石缝里一挤，我就掉进了这条河。
lines.en: Squeezed from a crevice, I fell into this river.

lines.zh: 有水的洼地，早晚会生出一条白鱼。
lines.en: Any pool with water will sooner or later grow a white fish.

lines.zh: 我出生时，第一眼看见的是石头的影子。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a stone's shadow.

lines.zh: 别找我，我会自己游到有光的地方。
lines.en: Do not look for me; I will swim to the light myself.

lines.zh: 水这么凉，火却烧到我背上。
lines.en: The water is cold, yet fire burns my back.

lines.zh: 被抛上岸那一刻，我连鳃都张不开。
lines.en: Thrown onto land, I cannot even open my gills.

lines.zh: 我本是水里的，怎么会淹到自己？
lines.en: I live in water — how could I drown in it?

lines.zh: 一声闷响，河底的石头都翻了。
lines.en: A muffled blast turns the riverbed stones over.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿进水里，擦过我的背鳍。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the water and grazes my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 一股怪力扯住我，水都变了颜色。
lines.en: A strange force drags at me and the water changes colour.

lines.zh: 这么久没吃东西，我连游都轻飘飘。
lines.en: So long without food that my swimming feels weightless.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我全身的鳞都立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river; every scale on me stands up.

lines.zh: 水没有了，下面只剩一片空。
lines.en: The water is gone, and only emptiness remains below.
